bm_lab_desc: Lab benches crowded with oscilloscopes and coffee cups. A sample tray lies smashed on the floor. #bm_office_detail.cap#.
A clean room gone filthy: a centrifuge spins down, a fume hood whines and a whiteboard is covered in equations and a frantic X.
A long lab under strip lights, with glass-fronted cabinets and a sign that reads AUTHORISED PERSONNEL ONLY.
bm_office_desc: A corridor of offices with nameplates and frosted glass. Ceiling panels hang down and a light flickers. #bm_office_detail.cap#.
An open-plan office in beige and grey. Papers drift across the carpet in the breeze of a broken vent. #bm_office_detail.cap#.
bm_office_detail: a phone on a desk rings and rings
a fluorescent tube buzzes and stutters
the sprinklers have been going for hours
a coffee pot has boiled dry on its hotplate
a radio somewhere plays muzak to nobody
there are scorch marks where something warped in
bm_maint_desc: A narrow service corridor of exposed pipes and conduit, lit by caged red lamps. Steam vents from a cracked valve.
Concrete walls stencilled with sector codes, a catwalk over a sump, and a lot of noise from machinery you can't see.
A cramped access way where ladders and pipe runs meet. Somewhere water drips in a steady, maddening rhythm.
bm_terminal_text: SYSTEM ERROR: CONTACT IT SUPPORT. IT SUPPORT HAS BEEN CONTACTED. IT SUPPORT IS NOT RESPONDING.
SECURITY ADVISORY: ALL PERSONNEL REPORT TO THE NEAREST SURFACE EXIT. THIS IS NOT A DRILL.
Inventory: 1 x sample cart, 1 x crystal sample (GG-3883). Notes: purity unprecedented. Handle with care.
scientist_chatter: We have to get to the surface! Someone must have called for help by now.
I knew this would happen. I said it, at the meeting, and nobody listened.
Have you seen my colleague? Short, glasses, terrified? No? Of course not.
If you're going that way, I'm not.
guard_chatter: Stay behind me. Or in front of me. Actually, just stay close.
Whatever you do, don't go back the way I came.
I'm supposed to be on a break right now.
Catch me later, I'll buy you a beer.
hecu_chatter: Black Ops? Here? That's not good.
I didn't sign up for aliens.
surface_desc: Red rock walls rise on either side of a dusty wash. The sky is an enormous, merciless blue. Somewhere, helicopters.
A scrubby mesa top with a view across the desert to the facility's chimneys and dishes. Smoke rises from several of them.
A dirt road winding between boulders, tyre tracks everywhere, and the smell of cordite.
camp_desc: Olive-drab tents, crates of ammunition and a radio table. Somebody left a pot of coffee on a field stove.
Sandbags, razor wire and a parked humvee. A whiteboard lists grid references and the word CONTAIN, underlined.
xen_desc: A chunk of rock hangs in a swirling green-violet void, other islands drifting at impossible distances. Gravity feels negotiable.
Spongy alien ground crusted with glowing crystals. Below, there is no below.
A cliff of pale, porous rock where light-stalks sway. Something enormous moves in the far haze.
racex_desc: Walls of glossy organic resin, ribbed like the inside of an animal. Pods twitch and drip.
A cavern grown rather than built, lit by bioluminescent veins that pulse in time with something huge.

bm_facility.title: The Black Mesa Research Facility
bm_facility.text: Black Mesa is a decommissioned missile base in the New Mexico desert, rebuilt as a sprawling research complex. Most of it is underground, sector after sector, connected by an automated tram system.

bm_hev.title: The HEV suit
bm_hev.text: The Hazardous Environment suit was designed for work around radiation and toxic materials. The Mark IV adds power armour, an injector system and a talkative computer. Nobody designed it for combat. It turned out to be very good at it anyway.

bm_xen.title: Xen
bm_xen.text: Black Mesa's teleportation research had made contact with another world: a borderworld scientists called Xen, made of floating islands, strange fauna and crystals. Samples were brought back. Some of them were very pure.

bm_lambda.title: The Lambda Complex
bm_lambda.text: The Lambda Complex is Black Mesa's teleportation research centre, built around a reactor big enough to hold a doorway between worlds open.

bm_hecu.title: The HECU
bm_hecu.text: The Hazardous Environment Combat Unit is a Marine Corps formation trained for chemical, biological and other unusual battlefields. Their orders at Black Mesa were to contain the incident. Their orders said nothing about survivors.

bm_black_ops.title: The Black Ops
bm_black_ops.text: Black-clad operatives arrived after the Marines: silent, acrobatic, answering to nobody anyone can name. They didn't come to contain. They came to erase.

bm_tram.title: The tram system
bm_tram.text: The Black Mesa Transit System runs automated trams between sectors. Its recorded announcer is cheerful about everything, including the facility's mandatory radiation safety training.

bm_headcrab.title: Headcrabs
bm_headcrab.text: Headcrabs are Xen parasites. They leap for the head of a host and take over its nervous system. The result is a zombie. The host may still be aware. Nobody wants to think about that.

bm_vortigaunt.title: Vortigaunts
bm_vortigaunt.text: The vortigaunts wear collars and shackles. Whoever is sending them through, they are not volunteers.

bm_racex.title: Race X
bm_racex.text: Not everything coming through the rifts is from Xen. A second alien race - shock troopers, pit drones, voltigores - is using the chaos to invade. The soldiers started calling them Race X.
